The card's family-config/GymnasiumDriver decision is kept; there is no DEVIATION FROM THE CARD. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD'S MOCK PREFERENCE: the upstream simulator mock was not run; the fake is F0.

CONTRACT: the bridge derives cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 from the fake's spaces. The action is 12 values (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:54) and the policy observation is 48 values (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:55; the layout in spdrbot3_env.py:79-98 sums to 48). A full reset samples the three commands uniformly from -1.0 to 1.0 (spdrbot3_env.py:157-158). The action Box is unbounded: the clone states only the action dimension, the bounds are built by the external DirectRLEnv, and the package declares no numeric bound and no action_space_ref. The gate therefore reports G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (there is no sourced numeric limit to probe). The action dimension 12 and the observation dimension 48 are sourced dimensions, not invented bounds.

FAKE AND F0 TIMING: fake.py is an analytic pure-Python stand-in for one environment, not the simulator. It keeps the native reset(seed=None, options=None), step(action) and close() surface and the batched shapes of num_envs = 1. Its 20 ms control period is 0.005 s (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:59-60) times decimation 4 (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:52); the fake advances a step counter, not wall time. It truncates at 999 steps: episode_length_s 20.0 (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:51) divided by the 20 ms control period is 1000, and spdrbot3_env.py:139 compares episode_length_buf >= max_episode_length - 1. The upstream randomizes episode_length_buf on a full reset (spdrbot3_env.py:152-154); the fake starts every episode at 0 and does not model that. The fake's root velocities, projected gravity, joint defaults, joint velocities and reward inputs are marked placeholders; the upstream reward formula is evaluated on zero root velocities and torques, and terminated is always false because the contact-force death check (spdrbot3_env.py:138-145) has no contact sensor in the fake. There is no physics, contact, actuator, sensor, terrain, noise or rendering model, and no snapshot/restore. The upstream observation_space is the external DirectRLEnv's batched policy Box while _get_observations returns a {'policy': ...} dict; the fake declares a Dict space so the announced space and the returned observation agree, which is an adaptation disclosed in the fidelity gaps.

REAL PATH AND DEPLOYMENT: only the fake backend is declared. A backend name that backends does not list (sim) would fall through to gymnasium.make(env_id) in GymnasiumDriver.open_native; that path was NOT run and is not claimed. The registered task passes env_cfg_entry_point as a keyword while Spdrbot3Env.__init__ requires cfg (spdrbot3_env.py:23), so gymnasium.make(env_id) alone does not construct it. The config also imports SPDRBOT_CFG from isaaclab_assets.robots.spdrbot (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:19), a module that is not part of this clone; root spdrbot.py defines a same-named object but is not importable at that module path. A live deployment needs Isaac Sim 4.5 (setup.py:38-42), Isaac Lab and isaaclab_assets (README.md:15-26, extension.toml:17-22), a GPU, the caller's cfg, the registration import and the asset module; environment construction, seeds, spaces, PhysX dynamics and the vectorized 200-environment training view were not validated. The upstream is vectorized (spdrbot3_env_cfg.py:92 declares 200 environments); the fake presents one environment and multi-environment control is not exposed. No sim backend is served, so no real ROS, Isaac or hardware run is established by this fake evidence.

SAFETY: simulated R0. The safe state is the SDK's software latch: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the world state stays readable. There is no hardware backend, no physical e-stop and no hardware limit. The repository advertises a physical SPDR Bot purchase link (README.md:29-33) but ships no hardware driver in this clone; no device is attached.

WARNINGS left by the last gate run, all expected and none failing: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset, so the bridge makes no native call); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close (they come from the external DirectRLEnv base outside the clone); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (the action space is unbounded, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.values and seed twice. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.
